// sifting table with two seats mid-room, a lantern on the south flour stack. Lanes: x=10 from the ladder landing
// (9,12,20) north to z=13, and x=12 from z=13 north to the stair foot (11,12,13). All drawn with layers().

  b: ["barrel", { facing: "up" }],                         // flour barrels

input.summary:
Mehlboden furnished in parts/room-6.mjs with layers(): 27 blocks in the box, a stair-step stack (spruce stairs with plank supports) up to the loft door, a barrel and hay flour store on the west, a sifting table with two stair seats mid-room, and standing lanterns on a post, a hay sack and a barrel. make.sh whole, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE for this part; room light min 9, 0 dark.</summary>
<parameter name="finished">true
left: Walk verdict is still NEEDS WORK: mcd room reports 0 of 62 floor cells reachable from the entrance. Cause is outside this part: no part builds the attic ladder (9,7..11,20) and its backing (9,7..10,21); shell.mjs calls stairHousing but never the attic ladder. Test copy with that ladder added (/tmp/mehl-check) still reports 0 reachable, so the tool may not climb ladders or may not stand on the landing (9,12,20), which has no solid block under it. Lanes checked by hand instead: x=10 is clear from z=13 to z=20 and x=12 from z=9 to z=13, so the stair foot (11,12,12) and the table are reachable once the ladder exists. Needs the ladder built by room 5 or P1, and the landing rule checked.
The landing (9,12,20) sits above the ladder top (9,11,20) with no solid support, so a player's exit from the ladder is only approximate; the plan's exit cell may need to be (10,12,20).
The room checklist items in elements.md (interior) and plan.md's Notes are not ticked: this is one room of the interior item, and the walk gate is not yet green.

waste.what: Drew the 13x5x3 furniture grid by hand in layers() rows, then re-checked each cell's support, lane and light by reading the floor grid.
waste.cost: about 40 cells placed by reasoning over coordinates; one full draft pass and one redraw.
waste.tool: A `mcd room --draft` or a plan mode that takes a list of furniture items (block, cell, facing) and returns the layers() rows, support violations and lanes in one go.

waste.what: Hand-checked lanes and stair headroom instead of getting a walk verdict, because the walk tool says the room is unreachable.
waste.cost: about 3 minutes; the walk tool could not show whether lanes inside the box were clear.
waste.tool: `mcd walk --from <cell>` (walk from any start cell, e.g. the ladder landing) so a room can be verified even while its way in is still being built.

waste.what: Wrote a test copy with the missing attic ladder to see the walk, then found the tool still does not reach the loft.
waste.cost: 2 test runs and a grep of the walk code for ladder handling.
waste.tool: The plan's ladder should be a named vocab item (atticLadder) that the shell calls, so the way in is built by the part that owns it, and the walk tool should state whether it climbs ladders.
